nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=25 beats='During holiday week, Miri unlocks Willowbank School and carries corn and fresh water toward the chicken yard for the morning hen check'>>

<<FILL role=setup words=45 beats='Dot and Goldie hurry from the coop, but tiny brown Pip does not follow; Miri checks the secure latch, counts twice, and finds fresh straw near the fence; she keeps the other hens safe and chooses where to begin searching'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=25 beats='Miri closes Dot and Goldie inside their run, takes the corn tin, and begins a slow circle around the quiet chicken yard'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=25 beats='Miri secures the run, wipes her shoes, and enters the quiet classroom where the holiday care chart hangs beside the feed cupboard'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=45 beats='Beside the fence, Miri finds three clean brown feathers caught on a twig; near the rain barrel, small three-toed prints cross a muddy patch; both could belong to Pip, so Miri decides which clue to study first'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=45 beats='The care chart says Pip seeks low, dark corners on windy days; a note from caretaker Mr. Bell mentions yesterday’s fence repair; branches tap the window, and Miri chooses between using the chart or asking Mr. Bell'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=25 beats='The unbroken feathers form a short line toward a hedge gap, where bent leaves and one strand of straw point into the school garden'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=25 beats='Miri follows the prints behind the rain barrel until they split between the shadowy tool shed and a shallow water dish by the fence'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=25 beats='Miri carries the chart outside and compares its picture of hiding Pip with the rhubarb leaves and overturned wheelbarrow in the school garden'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=25 beats='Miri finds Mr. Bell sweeping by the side gate; he lends her a torch and recalls hearing a hen near the repaired fence'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=45 beats='Beyond the hedge gap, tiny prints circle the broad rhubarb leaves; a faint peep also sounds near the overturned wheelbarrow, though its loose handle squeaks in the wind; Miri chooses whether to trust the prints or the sound'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=45 beats='The tool shed door stands slightly open, with potting soil scattered across its floor; beside the water dish, one fresh footprint leads toward a leafy fence corner; Miri decides which sign is more likely to reveal Pip'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=45 beats='The chart picture matches two sheltered places: a warm hollow beneath the rhubarb and a dark space behind stacked plant pots near the compost bin; Miri listens for a cluck and chooses which hiding corner to approach'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=45 beats='The repaired wire is firm, so Pip has not reached the road; straw clings to Mr. Bell’s garden cart, while fresh scratches pass beneath a low compost step; Miri chooses which safe place they should inspect together'>>
<<FILL role=climax words=25 beats='Miri kneels beside the largest leaf, hears a bubbling cluck underneath, and lifts the heavy green edge slowly with both hands'>>
<<FILL role=climax words=25 beats='A brown tail feather appears below the wheelbarrow; Miri blocks the garden path and raises one light handle without tipping the barrow'>>
<<FILL role=climax words=25 beats='Sunlight reveals hen prints crossing spilled soil toward a narrow gap beneath the shed wall, but no answering cluck comes from inside'>>
<<FILL role=climax words=25 beats='Miri places three corn kernels beside the water dish, sits very still, and watches the leafy corner without calling or chasing'>>
<<FILL role=climax words=25 beats='Warm straw fills a hollow beneath the leaf; Miri hears a soft cluck and notices a small brown shape guarding something pale'>>
<<FILL role=climax words=25 beats='Miri calls Pip in her calm feeding voice; a flowerpot wobbles, and a proud brown head rises behind the stack'>>
<<FILL role=climax words=25 beats='Mr. Bell steadies the cart while Miri checks the straw-lined shelf beneath it; they hear a worried cluck behind a folded net'>>
<<FILL role=climax words=25 beats='Miri shines the torch below the wooden step and sees feathers beside a harmless loop of loose garden mesh; Mr. Bell kneels nearby'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=45 beats='Pip sits safely in a snug straw nest beneath the rhubarb, with one small egg tucked under her; Miri guides Pip home with corn, carries the egg carefully, and marks the secret nesting place on the holiday chart'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=45 beats='Pip strolls from beneath the wheelbarrow, dusty but unharmed; Miri sets the barrow upright, leads Pip back with a corn trail, fastens the coop latch, and happily counts Dot, Goldie, and Pip twice'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=65 beats='The trail ends at dry leaves beyond the shed, and pickup time arrives before Pip appears; Miri feels disappointed, but she secures Dot and Goldie, leaves food and water, draws every clue on a clear map, and reports the missing hen to Mr. Bell so the careful search can continue'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=45 beats='After a long rustle, Pip steps from the leafy corner and drinks; she pecks the waiting corn, then follows Miri calmly to the coop; Miri checks the latch and adds a spare garden water dish to the care plan'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=45 beats='The brown shape is Pip, and the pale object is her first hidden egg; Miri gives Pip room to stand, then guides her toward the coop; the chart gains a bright note about checking warm nesting hollows'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=45 beats='Pip is perched on a round flowerpot like a tiny brown queen; she hops down for corn and follows Miri through the garden; Mr. Bell moves the pots away from the path before all three hens share breakfast'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=45 beats='Mr. Bell lifts the folded net while Miri tempts Pip from the cart shelf with corn; Pip emerges safely, and the pair fasten the net in a closed cupboard before returning the smallest hen to her friends'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=45 beats='Mr. Bell loosens the garden mesh, but Pip has already slipped out beside the pots; their cleared path and corn help her return safely; Miri records the discovery and helps secure the mesh for the next morning'>>

ending.title: The Empty Loop and Safe Return
